site.title: bench
site.description: Run a team of coding agents without losing track of what they are doing.

pages.title: bench — run a team of coding agents, stay in control
pages.description: Your agents ship faster than you can keep track. Every task is a card, every agent gets its own worktree, every change waits as a PR. Nothing merges without you.

pages.title: Install and first run
pages.description: Untar bench into .task-manager/, run start.sh, and answer the three questions the first run asks.

pages.title: The five stages
pages.description: backlog, to-do, in-progress, review, done — the directory a task file sits in is its status, and there is no other source of truth.

pages.title: Task files
pages.description: A task is a markdown file with a numbered name and a short header. Status is the only field the board enforces.

pages.title: Claiming a card
pages.description: Claiming is moving: taking a card towards work is the commitment, and that is where ownership is recorded.

pages.title: Agents on the board
pages.description: Start work makes a worktree and a branch, runs the agent headless, and moves the card on the way it exits.

pages.title: PRs and review
pages.description: A card entering review gets a PR opened for it by the board; then review PR, copilot and act on PR, until it settles.

pages.title: Team mode
pages.description: BOARD_SYNC makes origin/main the truth and every board a converging replica: moves commit and push themselves, and a beat pulls what the other boards published.

pages.title: The three-layer law
pages.description: Core knows tasks, worktrees, PRs and events. Drivers know apps, adapters know agent vendors, local/ knows your project.

pages.title: Agent adapters
pages.description: Headless jobs run through an adapter, so the board works with coding agents other than Claude Code — and never sees a vendor's payloads.
pages.lede: The adapter is the layer that knows a coding agent. It launches one headless job, and translates that vendor's events into the board's own schema — which is what keeps every other line of core free of any particular agent.
